chunks: From him, from Ahmad, from al-Barqi, from Ja'far ibn al-Muthanna, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Do I eat during the night of Ramadan until I doubt [whether it is time to stop]?' He said, 'Eat until you do not doubt.'
ai.seo_question: When does the time for pre-dawn eating end in Ramadan according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the principle of *istishab* (presumption of continuity) in Fiqh, allowing the believer to rely on the certainty of night until clear signs of dawn appear. It alleviates the burden of precise astronomical calculation, emphasizing ease (*taysir*) in worship. This ruling is foundational for determining the start of the daily fast (*sawm*) in Shia jurisprudence.
